title: AI assists a proof of Ehrhart positivity for integral polypositroids
summary: Luis Ferroni reports a proof that every coefficient of the Ehrhart polynomial of an integral polypositroid is positive.
ai_technology: GPT-6 Astra; GPT-6.2 Astra; Claude Opus 5.5
